why: rc32: English text keeps the game font and size

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc32 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: English (untranslated) text in the quest list, the quest tracker and tooltips could end up in our Persian font at a frozen size, so it became small when the font size was set low and did not grow again. Cause: two parts of the addon remembered the font of a line as its original after the other one had already replaced it. There is now one record of the game's own font per line, the size sliders only touch lines that really show Persian, and English lines always go back to the game's font and size.
Includes rc7 to rc31.
